title: Machine selection
description: Projects share universe Test Machines and compete for each host's one serial lease through one queue. The QA requirement token test-machine:NAME selects a registered resource. Single-host admission derives OS only from method_config.os/platform, executable steps, capability requirements or declared machines’ registered os and automatically admits only verified, healthy hosts. The selected driver must carry every tag declared in method_config.capability_tags. Machine settings store capability_tags as comma-separated text. When every matching host is leased, the refused single-host case joins the one Test Machine queue eligible for every verified host matching its OS and tags; whichever of them frees first goes to the oldest waiter it can serve, so a second host of the same OS serves the same queue. A pinned case, or one resuming on the host holding its state, waits only for that host. Instructions never choose an OS. An undeclared platform refuses with test_machine_platform_undeclared and asks for method_config.os or method_config.test_machine. Simultaneous cases retain the declared driver, admit each registered host and require the declared platform somewhere in the full set. A missing platform refuses with registration and verification recovery.
